gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests {@link LongestCommonSubsequence#longestCommonSubsequence(CharSequence, CharSequence)}.

The longest common subsequence (LCS) of two strings is the longe
ADDED i2: Each case describes one (left, right) input pair and the expected longest common subsequence. The leading text is only a human-readable label shown in the test
ADDED i3: No common subsequence -> empty result.
ADDED i4: Partial overlap -> a shorter shared subsequence.
ADDED i5: Identical inputs -> the whole string is common.
